angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 153,819 km at 12.61 pc = 0.16 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 79.3206 +/- 0.0182 mas (same row, RUWE 1.23): 12.61 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.2211 +/- 0.0069 solar radii from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract): 153,819 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.1945 +/- 0.0048 solar masses from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3229 +/- 78 K from Xue et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Xue et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of GJ 1132 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/gj-1132.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 5.038, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): spectral type M4.5 V, from Weisserman et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.165W/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.18 dex, from Weisserman et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...709A.165W/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -2.32148, from Xue et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJ...973L...8X/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): age 5 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): rotation period 122.3 d, from Bonfils et al. 2018 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...618A.142B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of GJ 1132 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
